parameters.query:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(r.payload::jsonb->>'slug', 'uex-id:' || (r.payload::jsonb->>'id')) AS dd_key,
         (r.payload::jsonb->>'id')::int AS dd_uex_id,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(r.payload::jsonb->>'date_modified', '')::bigint, 0) > 0 AS dd_has_data
  FROM uex_vehicles_raw_latest r
),
picked AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (dd_key) dd_key, format('vehicles:%s', dd_uex_id) AS keeper_sid
  FROM ranked ORDER BY dd_key, dd_has_data DESC, dd_uex_id ASC
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM picked p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vehicles v WHERE v.source_id = p.keeper_sid)) AS keeper_missing,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM vehicles v WHERE v.source = 'uex' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM picked p WHERE p.keeper_sid = v.source_id)) AS non_keeper_rows,
  (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT slug) FROM vehicles) AS dup_slug_rows
